summary: First E2E validation of ANCRA v2.0. All 30 backend pytest cases pass including AIAH streaming with Claude Sonnet 4.5. Frontend student dashboard, experience→lesson flow, faculty command center, curriculum builder (drag palette+canvas), analytics, all 9 ecosystem hubs, and the AIAH streaming dock verified with zero console errors. One config bug fixed: /app/backend/.env had CORS_ORIGINS and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY concatenated on the same line (missing newline), preventing dotenv from loading the LLM key and returning 500 from /api/aiah/stream.

minor.issue: System prompt says 'no markdown headers' but assistant still emitted '**Next step:**' markdown in test response. Cosmetic.

ui_bugs.issue: Song tiles missing data-testid (spec expected e.g. song-*-tile). Tiles render but not selectable for tests.

issues: Confirmed dark cinematic UI matches spec. No layout jumps observed during navigation across student → faculty → hub → lesson flows.

action_items: (Optional) Add data-testid="song-<id>" (or similar) to items in ThirtySong.jsx to allow targeted playwright tests.
(Optional) Tighten AIAH system prompt or post-process to strip markdown emphasis (**...**) so the cinematic tone is clean.
critical_code_review_comments: The /app/backend/.env file previously concatenated CORS_ORIGINS and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY on one line — dotenv logged 'could not parse statement starting at line 3'. Fixed by inserting a newline. Recommend adding a lint/pre-commit check for env files.
server.py is a single 379-line file with all routes; acceptable for MVP but consider splitting student/faculty/aiah routers as it grows past 700 lines.
seed_db() is idempotent (only inserts when collection empty). Good.
clean() helper defined but /me is the only place clean() is called; list_col already projects _id:0. Fine.
AIAH endpoint catches broad Exception and yields error into SSE — good. No auth on any endpoint (MVP; single active persona).
test_credentials: None required — single active student stu_maya_ellis and faculty fac_terrence_bloom served from seed via /api/me and dashboards.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds on startup (6 students, 3 faculty, 6 experiences, 4 lessons, 30 songs, 9 hubs, 3 cohorts, etc.). Verified counts via API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — run with `cd /app && pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py`. AIAH streaming validated (SSE, delta+done). If AIAH ever returns 500 again first check /app/backend/.env for proper newlines and EMERGENT_LLM_KEY presence. Frontend testids to trust: nav-*-link, role-switcher/role-student/role-faculty, aiah-dock/panel/input/send, palette-b1, canvas, canvas-block-c1, hub-launch-<module lowercase>, experience-tile-*, lesson-row-*.
rca of the issue: AIAH 500 root cause: /app/backend/.env line 3 was 'CORS_ORIGINS="*"EMERGENT_LLM_KEY="sk-emergent-..."' with no newline. python-dotenv failed to parse it and skipped EMERGENT_LLM_KEY, so os.environ.get('EMERGENT_LLM_KEY') returned None and the /api/aiah/stream handler raised HTTPException(500, 'AIAH not configured'). Mitigation: inserted newline; backend restarted; re-ran pytest — all 30 tests pass. Recommend a startup assertion that EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is present.
